name: The Nines
insider_take: Where Portland's storied past meets modern luxury — The Nines occupies the upper floors of a landmark building that once served as Oregon's grandest department store.
whats_special: Housed in the historic Meier & Frank Building (1909), this Luxury Collection gem rises above the iconic Pioneer Courthouse Square in the heart of downtown Portland. The hotel's stunning nine-story atrium — the architectural centerpiece from which the hotel draws its name — floods the interior with natural light and a sense of grand occasion. Original terracotta detailing and restored architectural elements blend seamlessly with contemporary design, while the walls are adorned with over $1 million worth of curated Pacific Northwest artwork.
pro_tip: Request a room on the upper floors facing Pioneer Courthouse Square for sweeping views of Portland's vibrant city center — especially magical during the holiday season when the square transforms into a winter wonderland.
dont_miss: Dine at Urban Farmer , the hotel's celebrated farm-to-table steakhouse, which sources ingredients from local Oregon farms and producers. Then head up to Departure Restaurant + Lounge on the rooftop for craft cocktails and panoramic views stretching from the Willamette River to Mt. Hood — one of Portland's most spectacular skyline vantage points.
pros: Prime downtown Portland location in historic building
Sophisticated luxury accommodations with modern amenities
Exceptional rooftop dining and cocktail experiences
Full-service spa and state-of-the-art fitness center
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects upscale positioning
Urban setting may have typical city noise levels
